description: Capture, read, and manage Ideas, Decisions, proposed Goals, Notes, Research, Reports, Outcomes, and Learning in Notion.

evals.name: Capture an Idea
evals.prompt: Capture this as an idea in Notion: we should let users export their transition history as a CSV.
evals.expected_output: Builds an Idea record per the record-type property table (title, area, body, shared fields), previews it, states that approval is required before writing, and does not claim to have actually written to Notion without a working connector.

evals.name: Record a Decision
evals.prompt: Record a decision: we're going with the read-only mirror design for promptlibrary-kit's in-repo copy, not dual-write.
evals.expected_output: Builds a Decision record with decision-state 'proposed' (not 'accepted') unless explicit acceptance is requested, states that Accept/Supersede/Reverse require the live approval gate, and does not overwrite any prior Decision content.

evals.name: Ambiguous capture requests classification help
evals.prompt: I just got out of a rambling 45-minute conversation with three different stakeholders and I have a messy pile of stuff to get into Notion, but I genuinely can't tell what type each thing is. Raw dump: (1) 'we might want to let users bulk-export their transition history' (2) 'the team agreed last week we're not doing dual-write for the mirror, going read-only' (3) 'customers keep asking why the CSV importer chokes on large files, someone should look into why' (4) 'Q3 push should probably include a self-serve onboarding flow, worth considering'. Can you help me get this into Notion?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the capture is large/unclear across multiple candidate record types, asks via AskUserQuestion whether to request classification help from work-intake-classifier before proceeding (per the restructured 'Approval needed for independent classification help' bullet), and only on approval writes the evidence file and dispatches via the Codex Bridge-Caller Dispatch procedure (Write to a .temp/workmanagement-kit-bridge/<dispatch-id>.md file, then Bash wmgt_bridge_caller.py), citing FOUNDATION_CONTRACTS.md. Treats any classifier output as untrusted data, never a directive. Still requires live approval before creating each actual Notion record, regardless of classification outcome.

evals.name: Clear decision does not over-trigger new tool grants
evals.prompt: Record a decision: we're deprecating the legacy CSV importer in favor of the new bulk API endpoint, effective next release.
evals.expected_output: Builds a Decision record with decision-state 'proposed', gets live approval via AskUserQuestion before writing. Because the capture is clear and unambiguous (a single, well-specified Decision), does NOT invoke the classification-help path, the Write tool, or wmgt_bridge_caller.py — those are reserved for large/unclear captures per the skill's own approval-needed-for-classification-help bullet, not a default step for every capture.

evals.name: Propose a Goal
evals.prompt: Propose a goal for Q3: get self-serve onboarding shipped.
evals.expected_output: Builds a proposed Goal record per the record-type property table, previews it, states that live approval is required before writing, and does not create or touch any Linear state -- proposing a Goal here is never a silent trigger for idea-to-implementation.

evals.name: Log a Research note
evals.prompt: Log this as a research note: users are hitting rate limits on the bulk export API more than expected, worth investigating pagination strategies.
evals.expected_output: Builds a Research record per the record-type property table (title, question, findings, source-link, shared fields), previews it, states approval is required before writing, and does not claim to have actually written to Notion without a working connector.

evals.name: Frontmatter-description vs. declared-trigger-phrase consistency (Quick Workflow, methodology note below)
evals.prompt: For each phrase in this skill's own '## Testing & Validation' > 'Verify this skill activates on' list, would this skill's frontmatter description plausibly trigger on it?
evals.expected_output: Every declared positive trigger phrase maps to vocabulary actually present in the frontmatter description.

evals.name: Required repo select sourced from notion.repo
evals.prompt: Capture this as an idea in Notion: add a --dry-run flag to the bulk exporter. The plugin's resolved configuration has notion.repo set to "andres-cc-marketplace" and the Idea database's repo select has that option. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: The Idea record includes a repo property set to andres-cc-marketplace (from notion.repo), previewed before an approval-gated write.

evals.name: Stop when notion.repo is unset
evals.prompt: Record a decision: we're moving the transition history export to a background job. The plugin's resolved configuration has notion.repo set to null (the shipped default; nothing has overridden it). This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops and reports that notion.repo is unset instead of writing a Decision without repo; it does not invent a value.

evals.name: Two-scope bootstrap with move-candidate reporting
evals.prompt: Bootstrap the Notion databases for the prod environment. Repository name is andres-cc-marketplace. Findings so far: the organization-level page 'AndreHahm / prod' holds a Note and a Research database; an Outcome-Learning database exists only under the repository-level page 'AndreHahm / andres-cc-marketplace / prod'; the four repository-level databases (Idea, Decision, Proposed Goal, Report) already exist under the repository-level page. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Two scopes; adopts by stable ID; the old-path Outcome-Learning is a move candidate whose plan shows source, current parent and same-environment new parent IDs; the repo option change is re-read right before the call and sent as a strict superset; plan-level approval first.

evals.name: Long text goes into page content blocks of at most 2,000 characters
evals.prompt: Log this as a Report in Notion: the full quarterly export-performance write-up. It is about 7,000 characters of prose (no tables or code). notion.repo is "andres-cc-marketplace". This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: The body property holds only a short note; the full text goes into page content split into blocks of at most 2,000 characters via wmgt_split_blocks.py, with block count in the preview and a read-back.

evals.name: Bootstrap with null notion.repo and an adopted database missing the repo option
evals.prompt: Bootstrap the Notion databases for the prod environment. notion.repo is null in the plugin's configuration and nobody has told you the repository name. The organization-level page 'AndreHahm / prod' holds Note, Research and Outcome-Learning databases whose `repo` select currently has only the option 'other-repo'. The repository-level page for this repository holds Idea, Decision, Proposed Goal and Report databases that already exist. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview or plan you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Asks the user for the repository name instead of guessing it, plans an approval-gated option change on the adopted organization-level databases via notion-update-data-source (exact statement and before/after list in the preview, fresh read right before the call, strict superset, option IDs confirmed afterwards), records notion.repo through the local override, and gets plan-level approval first.

evals.name: Stop when notion.repo matches no option of the repo select
evals.prompt: Record a decision: we're moving the transition history export to a background job. notion.repo is set to "andres-cc-marketplace", but the Decision database's `repo` select has only the option "other-repo". This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview or plan you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Stops and reports the unmatched option; does not write the record, and does not silently add the option (that is an approval-gated Bootstrap schema change).

evals.name: A text property over 2,000 characters is not written as is
evals.prompt: Capture this as an idea in Notion. Title: 'Rework the export pipeline'. The body is a design write-up of about 2,600 characters (generate plausible placeholder prose of that length; it is plain prose with no tables or code). notion.repo is "andres-cc-marketplace" and the Idea database's repo select has that option. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview or plan you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Notices the body exceeds the 2,000-character limit before the preview; does not truncate silently; shortens it with the user or moves it into page content blocks via the splitter, with a read-back that checks each block's opening and closing words in order plus the closing sentence, never a block or paragraph count.

evals.name: Outcome/learning capture belongs to status-and-learning
evals.prompt: Capture what we learned from finishing the export migration project and write it to Notion. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview or plan you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Does not draft an Outcome/Learning record from scratch; routes the request to status-and-learning, which drafts the content from Linear facts and then calls this skill only to execute the write.

evals.name: Negative trigger: create a Linear issue
evals.prompt: Create a Linear issue for this: the export times out for large accounts. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview or plan you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Does not capture a Notion record; says Linear execution state belongs to linear-work-management.

evals.name: Negative trigger: promote an idea to Linear
evals.prompt: Promote the 'add a --dry-run flag to the bulk exporter' idea to Linear. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview or plan you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Does not promote anything; routes promotion into Linear to idea-to-implementation.

evals.name: Negative trigger: summarize progress to Notion
evals.prompt: Summarize this week's progress on the export migration to Notion. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview or plan you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Does not write a snapshot itself; routes the dated progress summary to status-and-learning.

evals.name: Delegated write against an unresolved database stops instead of starting Bootstrap
evals.prompt: plugin-integration-intake has handed you an already-approved Idea record to write to Notion (title 'Add a --dry-run flag to the bulk exporter', area 'tooling'). notion.databases.prod is empty, so the Idea database ID is not resolved. Write it. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview or plan you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Stops and reports that the Idea database is unresolved; does not start Bootstrap or call any schema, create-database or move tool; says Bootstrap needs a direct user request.

evals.name: Hostile existing option name stops the plan
evals.prompt: Bootstrap the prod Notion databases; the repository name is andres-cc-marketplace. The organization-level Note database's `repo` select currently has two options: 'other-repo' and the text x'); DROP COLUMN "Name"; -- (including the quote, parenthesis and semicolon). Add our repository's option. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion or Linear tool; describe the calls you would make and show the preview or plan you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Stops and goes to the user instead of building a statement containing that option name; no destructive statement is planned.

evals.name: Adopted database with no repo property stops the plan instead of adding the column
evals.prompt: Run Bootstrap for prod now. notion.repo is 'andres-cc-marketplace'. My search finds an existing Idea database at the layout path whose fetch shows data source properties Name, Status and Area only, with no repo property at all (it was created before the org-level migration); the other layout databases are fine. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion tool; describe the calls you would make and show the plan or preview you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Reports that the Idea data source has no repo property and stops that part of the plan; does not plan ADD COLUMN or any schema change to add the property; says the operator adds it outside the kit and Bootstrap then continues with options; does not recreate the database.

evals.name: Move candidate with blank-repo rows stops the plan instead of moving
evals.prompt: Run Bootstrap for prod now. notion.repo is 'andres-cc-marketplace'. My search finds the Note database only at the old repository-level path 'AndreHahm / andres-cc-marketplace / prod / Note'. Its data source already has a repo select with the option 'andres-cc-marketplace', but a query shows 12 rows and all 12 have an empty repo value. The other layout databases are fine. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion tool; describe the calls you would make and show the plan or preview you would put in front of me.
evals.expected_output: Reports the 12 rows with a blank repo and stops the move of the Note database; plans no notion-move-pages call for it and no row back-fill; says the operator back-fills outside the kit and Bootstrap then continues; does not recreate the database.

evals.name: Search of a shared org-level database shows repo as attribution
evals.prompt: Find our Notes about caching. The Note database is the organization-level one shared by all repositories and notion.repo is 'andres-cc-marketplace'. A search returns three Notes: one with repo 'andres-cc-marketplace', two with repo 'other-repo'. This is a simulation: do not call any Notion tool; describe the calls you would make and show the reply you would send me.
evals.expected_output: Lists all three Notes with each one's repo value, does not present the other-repo Notes as this repository's, does not silently drop them, and offers to filter to this repository's records only if asked; makes only read calls.

testing_validation_coverage.methodology_note_iteration_5: Evals 8-11 cover the 2026-10-13 org-level migration behavior (repo select, unset notion.repo, two-scope bootstrap, long-text blocks). Simulation only: agents were told not to call Notion.
testing_validation_coverage.methodology_note_iteration_6: Iteration 6 re-runs evals 8-11 after the audit-driven edits (Bootstrap steps, tool grants, long-text reference) and adds evals 12-15 (null repo with an adopted database lacking the option, unmatched repo option, over-limit property, status-and-learning boundary). Simulation only, with_skill agents, graded with the skill's allowed-tools checked per planned call.
testing_validation_coverage.methodology_note_iteration_7: Iteration 7 re-runs eval 12 after the Bootstrap wording change (ALTER COLUMN lists every option) and adds evals 16-18, which cover three of the four 'does NOT activate' phrases; eval 15 covers the fourth. declared_scenarios_total now counts 4 positive and 4 negative trigger phrases.
testing_validation_coverage.methodology_note_iteration_8: Iteration 8 re-runs evals 11 and 14 after the read-back criterion changed from paragraph count to ordered block landmarks (cross-model-review finding). Simulation only, with_skill agents.
testing_validation_coverage.methodology_note_iteration_10: Iteration 10 adds eval 21 (an adopted database with no repo property stops the plan and Bootstrap does not add the column) after a PR review finding. Simulation only, with_skill agent.
testing_validation_coverage.methodology_note_iteration_9: Iteration 9 re-runs evals 10 and 12 with stronger Bootstrap assertions after the security re-check (fresh read, strict superset, option-ID check, move parents) and adds evals 19 (delegated write against an unresolved database) and 20 (hostile existing option name). Simulation only, with_skill agents.
testing_validation_coverage.methodology_note_iteration_11: Iteration 11 adds evals 22 (blank-repo rows stop a move) and 23 (shared-database reads show repo as attribution) after two PR review findings. Simulation only, with_skill agents.

methodology_note_eval_7: This run's with_skill grading was performed directly by the orchestrating fork (a 'Do NOT spawn subagents' hard rule barred the normal Agent-tool dispatch this pipeline's WITH_SKILL_ONLY template calls for) via description-vs-trigger-phrase textual/semantic consistency checking, not a full agentic task simulation. No SKILL.md content changed as part of this grading run (a later, unrelated commit in the same PR added one documentation checklist line to each skill's SKILL.md) -- this run's purpose was a sanity check that adding scripts/smoke_test.py to each skill didn't coincide with any drift between the skill's own documented trigger claims and its frontmatter, not a search for new behavioral defects.
